name: Huang Jianxun
current_role: Co-controlling shareholder of Guangdong Liantai Group (Shantou); former chairman of Shanghai-listed Guangdong Liantai Environmental Protection (603797)
profile: Huang Jianxun (黄建勲) is a member of the Huang family that controls Guangdong Liantai Group, a Shantou-based infrastructure, municipal construction and real-estate group founded in 1993, whose listed arm Liantai Environmental (603797.SH) runs wastewater treatment plants. He served as chairman of the listed company.
interesting_fact: Liantai Group grew out of Shantou Dahao Municipal Construction, which went to Shenzhen to build infrastructure in the special economic zone; the group later moved into wastewater-treatment PPP projects via Liantai Environmental.
notes: Very little public English info. SSE disciplinary decisions (2023/2024) named him as actual controller and then-chairman of Liantai Environmental over related-party fund use: https://www.sse.com.cn/disclosure/credibility/supervision/measures/ident/c/10762687/files/ff035baf77574dca933d5a2c3c91723d.pdf. Identity link to Hurun 'Lian Tai' inferred, not confirmed by Hurun page. Approach via company IR if at all.

name: Lu Zhilin
current_role: Director and General Manager, Guangdong OPT Machine Vision Tech Co. (688686.SH)
profile: Lu Zhilin (卢治临, b. 1983) co-founded Dongguan-based OPT Machine Vision with his brother Lu Shenglin in 2006 and has run it as general manager; he was chairman 2016-2018. OPT makes light sources, lenses, cameras and vision software for factory automation (notably consumer-electronics and lithium-battery lines) and listed on Shanghai's STAR Market in 2020.
interesting_fact: Before co-founding OPT he ran a small clothing shop, with only a junior-college (dazhuan) education.
deep_cut_fact: He co-founded the business in 2006 as Dongguan OPT Automation Technology Co., Ltd. at about age 23, alongside his brother Dr. Lu Shenglin, who serves as chairman.
notes: Low public profile; company IR (board secretary Xu Xueliang) is the realistic route. Forbes bio spells name 'Luo Zhilin' in one line.

name: Chris Ruddy
current_role: Founder, Chairman and CEO, Newsmax Inc. (NYSE: NMAX)
profile: Christopher Ruddy, a former investigative reporter at the New York Post and Pittsburgh Tribune-Review, founded Boca Raton-based Newsmax in 1998 and launched its cable channel in 2014, now among the largest US cable news networks. Newsmax listed on the NYSE in March 2025; Ruddy owns nearly a third of the shares.
interesting_fact: He started Newsmax in 1998 with a $25,000 investment from Mellon heir Richard Mellon Scaife; by 2024 the channel was the fourth-largest US news channel with ~30 million regular viewers.
deep_cut_fact: He turned down Columbia to join St. John's University's Honors Program (BA History, summa cum laude, 1987), later earned an MPP at the LSE, and as a student worked on the 'rapid response' team of Reagan's 1984 re-election campaign.
notes: High-profile media figure, accessible and frequently interviewed; route via Newsmax corporate/IR. He also speaks on energy/environment at EarthX (https://earthx.org/speaker/chris-ruddy/).
